children: Amazon (AMZN) runs drone delivery under FAA exemptions in CA, TX, AR, FL and UT; FAA said lifting exemptions would expand drone operations across industries.
Amazon (AMZN) expands AWS European Sovereign Cloud in Germany, building on its January 2026 Brandenburg debut and announcing €7.8 billion in investments from 2024–2040 to support local customers.
Lawmakers asked the FAA for a fresh environmental review of Amazon’s planned Prime Air drone hub near Westborough, MA, citing noise, health, safety, privacy and quality-of-life concerns.
Amazon (AMZN) expands live sports on Prime Video and Amazon MGM, keeps NFL Thursday Night Football and NBA rights, integrates ads and retail into broadcasts, spending about $3B yearly on rights.
Amazon (AMZN) will launch 36 Amazon Leo satellites via Arianespace no earlier than Nov 23. Amazon Leo now plans ~3,200 satellites; ~400 were in orbit as of early September.
India targets hyperscale data centers as a $200B opportunity. Govt vows policy to boost investment without raising consumer power costs. Amazon (AMZN) linked to planned expansions in India.
Amazon (AMZN) saw weaker smartphone sales during Navratri as traffic held but online device volumes fell; discounts narrowed and prices rose amid higher chip, currency and freight costs.
AMZN expands Prime Video content deals with Skydance, Warner Bros. Discovery and Paramount, adding Warner and Paramount-produced shows plus Paramount+ and HBO Max titles to Prime Video’s catalog.
Amazon (AMZN) rolls out 4,500+ electric delivery vans in Germany, ordered 27 Mercedes-Benz battery-electric trucks now—aiming 50+ by end-2026—and plans water-positive cloud ops by 2030.
